Karthik / Laura — adding HR context.

Summary of required artifacts to evaluate a probation extension or any change to status (see attached SOP):
- Written performance improvement plan (PIP) or documented coaching notes with dates and outcomes
- Evidence of 1:1s (calendar invites + brief notes) over the performance window
- A recommended extension length with explicit review date and measurable outcomes
- For any sensitive cases we will redact personal health or unrelated medical information; if accommodations exist, please forward documentation via secure People Ops channel.

Process notes:
- We require at least 5 business days lead time before the scheduled probation review to process paperwork for an extension.
- Any alternate manager messaging that deviates from template language must be reviewed by People Ops before being shared with the employee (simple edits are fine; legal escalates only when accommodations or disciplinary action is proposed).

Attachment: SOP-Performance-Probation.pdf (3 pages)
